title: perf-benchmarking-sync-2026-06-30
content:
Attendees: Asha Patel (owner), Liam Chen, Marisol Rivera, Devin Brooks, Riya Gupta (infra), Tomasz Nowak (release eng)

Summary:
- Quick sync to triage the latency and throughput regression observed in the nightly e2e perf runs from 2026-06-28 -> 2026-06-29. Regression impacts hosted and dedicated pools for T5-like and GPT-family model variants at medium sequence lengths.

Key numbers (end-to-end generation, 8k-context baseline vs current):
- Baseline (2026-06-27 nightly): model=gpt-medium-8k; hw=H100 80GB; batch=1; seq=512; p50=42ms; p95=78ms; throughput=11.8 tokens/s
- Current (2026-06-29 nightly): same config; p50=62ms (+48%); p95=145ms (+86%); throughput=7.1 tokens/s (-40%)
- Additional affected: t5-xxl 2048 seq: throughput dropped from 28.4 -> 18.6 tokens/s (-34%); p95 increased ~60ms
- Regression window: first red build at serving-runtime@commit: d4b2f3a (merged 2026-06-28 02:14 UTC)

What we ran / reproduction steps:
1) Local perf harness run (ci/perf/harness): commit d4b2f3a + hotfix candidate e8f9b2c (small kernel fallback)
   - Command: ./perf_harness --model gpt-medium-8k --seq 512 --batch 1 --gpu H100 --traces=on --runs=100
2) Cluster nightly job details: nightly-perf-2026-06-29 (k8s job id: nightly-perf-0629) referencing docker: gcr.io/redwood/serving-runtime:2026-06-28-rc3
3) Environment note: CUDA driver bumped on infra side from 12.1 -> 12.2 on 2026-06-27 (infra change planned for improved scheduling).

Initial hypotheses:
- Kernel selection change: recent kernel selection logic (commit d4b2f3a) prefers an experimental fused-attn kernel for seq lengths < 1024; fused kernel appears to regress on H100 for our medium-length workloads.
- cuBLAS/CUDA driver interplay: infra OTA to CUDA 12.2 may have changed perf characteristics; combination with new kernel triggers fallback to slower code path at scale.
- Memory layout/packing change in kv-cache update (commit d4b2f3a) causing extra memcpy on first tokens for some models.

Observations from traces and flamegraphs:
- Flamegraph from perf_harness (attached to confluence) shows large increase in time spent in fused_attn_forward and in memcpy_sync.
- GPU metrics: higher DRAM utilization and increased PCIe stalls during peak for the current builds.
- No change in model weights or tokenizer versions.

Quick experiments executed during the sync:
- Rollback kernel selection to previous heuristic (local patch): perf improved back to baseline p50~45ms, p95~81ms. Patch: revert selection in kernel_selector.cc (temp revert branch: revert-fused-pref-0629).
- Re-run on A100: regression smaller (~+10% p95). Indicates H100-specific interaction.
- Applied hotfix e8f9b2c which forces memcpy async and reduces p95 to ~95ms (partial improvement).

Decisions / short-term mitigations:
- Revert the kernel-selection change in the next canary images for hosted/dedicated (owner: Asha). Rollout plan: canary 10% for 24h then ramp. Target time: 2026-06-30 18:00 PT.
- Pin CUDA driver for nightly perf to 12.1 for triage (infra owner: Riya).
- Run expanded perf matrix across H100 variants (80GB and 96GB), and A100 for cross-check (owner: Liam).

Action items (owner [due]):
- Asha: Submit PR to revert kernel selection and include additional unit tests to cover kernel choice logic (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1248) [due 2026-06-30].
- Riya (infra): Rollback CUDA driver on perf cluster to 12.1 and re-run nightly-perf-0629; provide driver logs (JIRA: INFRA-1122) [due 2026-07-01].
- Liam: Run perf harness matrix (H100 80/96, A100) across seq lengths 128/512/1024 and produce a summary table in confluence page [due 2026-07-02].
- Marisol: Add more detailed tracing in fused_attn_forward to surface slow paths and specific kernel ids executed (instrumentation ticket: ENG-2387) [due 2026-07-03].
- Devin: Coordinate canary rollout with SRE and monitor latency SLOs / error budgets; prepare rollback playbook [due 2026-06-30].

Follow-ups / longer-term:
- Re-evaluate kernel selection heuristics with broader hardware matrix, include auto-ablation tests in CI to catch regressions on common GPU types.
- Add synthetic microbenchmarks for fused_attn kernels with controlled seq & batch parameters.
- Consider gating kernel rollout behind a perf regression check in PRs touching kernel_selector or attn code.

Notes / loose ends:
- We saw one sporadic OOM on H100 80GB during the stress job (coredump saved, Tomasz investigating). Not reproducible locally yet.
- Need to correlate customer-facing error spikes with our perf regression window (CS owning log pull).

Next sync: 2026-07-02 09:00 PT (standup format) to review canary metrics and infra rollback results.

Attachments / links: see linked_artifacts above and confluence perf page for graphs.

Raw test runs / commands (for reproducibility):
- git checkout d4b2f3a && ./perf_harness --model gpt-medium-8k --seq 512 --batch 1 --gpu H100 --runs 100 --output perf_d4b2f3a.json
- git checkout revert-fused-pref-0629 && ./perf_harness --model gpt-medium-8k --seq 512 --batch 1 --gpu H100 --runs 100 --output perf_revert.json
- cluster nightlies: kubectl logs nightly-perf-0629 -n perf --tail=500 > nightly-perf-0629.log
